description_blocks.text:
Legacy OpenBuilds V-Slot aluminium linear-rail reference with a 20 x 40 mm cross-section and exactly 500 mm CAD length. The file is not a parametric extrusion, and it does not represent other lengths or a live length/finish variant.

Legacy OpenBuilds design reference from the community-hosted mirage335 mirror of STEP Parts Library 1.5. The direct original STEP is retained unchanged, with OpenBuilds, LLC attribution and the recorded CC-BY-SA-4.0 license. This is not a current manufacturer-hosted download or a confirmed current hardware revision. No current SKU, price, stock or complete purchasable kit is inferred. Verify the chosen physical part and its manufacturer drawing before a fit-critical design. Other lengths, end tapping, cutting tolerances, anodizing, slot radii, mating T-nuts, wheel contact and fit are not established by this fixed-length CAD reference.
